nodes.plm_action: Apply lubricant to moving parts of jack
nodes.plm_caption: This video captures someone using a floor jack in a workshop. They hold a bottle of "Jack Oil" and point at the oil seal to show where they are inserting the tool. With a red and yellow handle the person turns the floor jack on and off. They use both hands at times to hold the jack and then only their right hand, but always keep their left hand in the shot. They move from holding the jack handle on the left to the right. They are wearing black shoes. There is a mat visible in the top left corner.

summary.brief: A person demonstrates how to add hydraulic fluid to a floor jack and then operates its pump handle.
summary.detailed: The video begins with the presenter holding two bottles of jack oil and pointing at the jack’s oil seal. He removes the jack’s cover, exposing a rubber seal and dip‑stick, then releases the pressure valve and checks the float inside. After opening the oil bottle, he pours new hydraulic fluid into the reservoir until the fill mark on the screw is visible, replaces the cover and re‑closes the valve. He then grasps the red‑and‑yellow pump handle, repeatedly pulls it up and pushes it down, causing the jack to raise and lower while a small stream of brown fluid drips from the seal, and finally sets the handle aside as the demonstration ends.

action.brief: Refill hydraulic fluid and pump the floor jack
action.detailed: Remove the jack’s cover, release the valve, add new hydraulic oil until the fill mark is reached, replace the cover, then repeatedly pull up and push down the red‑and‑yellow pump handle to raise and lower the jack while fluid drips from the seal.

nodes.plm_action: Apply oil to the jack
nodes.plm_caption: The video depicts a person changing oil on a jack. The person first displays two bottles of oil, then proceeds to take the oil dipstick out of the jack and clean off the dipstick. The person proceeds to remove the oil and pour in another before cleaning and putting back the oil dipstick in the machine and cleaning it off.

summary.brief: The presenter shows two oil bottles, removes the jack’s cover and float, refills the reservoir with hydraulic oil, and reassembles the unit.
summary.detailed: The video begins with the demonstrator displaying two bottles of hydraulic jack oil. He removes the jack’s protective cover, releases the relief valve, and pulls out the rubber float (dipstick) from the oil reservoir. After setting the float aside he checks the existing fluid level, then pours fresh hydraulic oil into the reservoir until the fill‑screw’s “M” mark is reached. He reinserts the float, closes the relief valve, and replaces the cover, completing the hydraulic‑fluid change.

action.detailed: Release the relief valve, remove the jack’s cover and float, add fresh hydraulic oil until the level reaches the M mark, then reinstall the float, close the valve and secure the cover.
action.actor: the demonstrator, a person operating the floor jack

nodes.plm_action: Apply oil and grease to the jack
nodes.plm_caption: The video shows a person's hand holding a red handle inserted into a hydraulic jack. The handle is pulled up and down, causing the jack to lift and lower up and down. The jack is situated on a marble-like platform with some tools on the side and around it.  As the handle is pulled, a brown liquid squirts out. It continues to be pulled and lifted back and forth before being laid on the ground, removed, and a new bottle of grease is pointed to. It's a demonstration of how a hydraulic jack works.

summary.brief: The operator pumps a hydraulic floor jack with its red handle, hydraulic fluid drips, then lowers the jack, puts the handle down and points to a grease bottle.
summary.detailed: The segment opens with a close‑up of a black hydraulic floor jack resting on a work surface, a red‑colored handle attached to it, and several tools nearby. A hand grasps the red handle and pulls it upward, causing the jack to extend and a brown hydraulic fluid to leak from the valve. The hand then pushes the handle downward, lowering the jack, and this up‑and‑down motion is repeated several times, producing a rhythmic pumping action with intermittent fluid leakage. After a few cycles the handle is fully depressed, the jack settles at its lowest position, the handle is removed and placed on the ground beside the tool set, and the camera shifts to show a bottle of grease being pointed at.

action.detailed: Pull the red handle upward to raise the jack, push it down to lower the jack, repeat the motion while hydraulic fluid drips from the valve, then fully depress the handle, lower the jack completely, remove the handle and set it on the ground, and point to the grease bottle.

nodes.plm_action: Get a jack oil
nodes.plm_caption:
This video shows a man working on a hydraulic floor jack. The video starts with a shot of the jack and various tools and oil bottles in the front of it. He lifts one of the bottles and holds it up for the camera. It's "gold eagle hydraulic jack oil". Then he puts it down, takes another bottle that is in the back of the jack and flips the cap. It's the same type oil, but from a different brand. Finally, he lifts up the front of the jack and shows that it has no oil inside of it.
The lighting in this video is decent. There's natural light behind the man, so no harsh shadows and good visibility. The camera is handheld, and it tracks the object with the man. The shot is static, so there are no motion effects in the video. There are also no other individuals in the shot besides the man.

summary.brief: A man displays two hydraulic jack‑oil bottles and checks that the floor jack is empty.
summary.detailed: The clip opens with a floor jack and assorted tools arranged on a concrete surface. The man lifts a bottle labeled “Gold Eagle Hydraulic Jack Oil” and holds it up for the camera, then puts it back down. He reaches to a second oil bottle that was positioned behind the jack, removes and flips its cap to show the label, and sets it aside. Next, he lifts the front cover of the jack, pulls out a black‑and‑red rectangular pump piece, and demonstrates that the jack’s hydraulic reservoir contains no oil.

action.brief: Show oil bottles and inspect empty jack
action.detailed: Pick up a jack‑oil bottle, show it to the camera, flip the cap of another bottle, set them down, open the jack’s front cover and pull out the internal pump piece to demonstrate that the jack is empty.

nodes.plm_action: Re releasing the hydraulic cylinder and applying more oil
nodes.plm_caption: The video captures a person fixing a jack in quick motions. A hand comes in and out as he removes a bolt and replaces it. The jack is placed over the flat surface. He then puts a red handle to the jack and removes the bolts on the ends and checks the other side. He points to different components and picks up another bottle. The jack is then seen on the ground moving upward. He then pushes a black bottle under it. He inserts the red handle again and pulls it upward as he starts to screw in the black bottle to the jack.  He repeats the same step but pushes down the jack again and repeats it. It is being shown in a time lapse.

summary.brief: The presenter removes the jack’s cover, releases the hydraulic valve, extracts the float, adds fresh hydraulic fluid, then closes the valve and replaces the cover.
summary.detailed: A person working on a floor jack first removes the protective cover to expose the rubber seal. They then locate and release the hydraulic valve. After the valve is open, the internal float is pulled out and set aside for inspection. The presenter uncorks a bottle of hydraulic oil and pours it into the jack’s reservoir, filling until the oil level reaches the mark on the fill screw. Once the proper level is reached, the float is re‑inserted, the hydraulic valve is closed, and the cover is snapped back into place, completing the fluid‑change procedure.

action.brief: Add hydraulic fluid to floor jack
action.detailed: Remove the jack’s cover, release the hydraulic valve, pull out the float, pour new hydraulic oil into the reservoir until the level reaches the fill mark, then replace the float, close the valve and reinstall the cover.
action.actor: the presenter (a person working on the floor jack)

nodes.plm_action: Push in lever with a long handle
nodes.plm_caption: A close-up video of someone filling a wheel using a red hose.

summary.brief: A hand pulls the red pump handle on a black floor jack, raising and lowering the jack.
summary.detailed: In a close‑up view, a black hydraulic floor jack rests on a concrete surface. A hand grips the long red pump handle, pulls it upward causing the jack to lift a short distance, then pushes the handle back down to lower the jack. This up‑and‑down motion is performed repeatedly within the short clip.

action.detailed: Pull the red pump handle upward to raise the jack, then push it back down to lower the jack, repeating the motion.
action.actor: A hand holding the red pump handle

nodes.plm_action: Pull hydraulic fluid out of oil using a squeegee
nodes.plm_caption: This video features an electric car jack being extended and then retracted repeatedly using its handle.  The video ends with the handle placed to the left of the machine.

summary.brief: A black‑and‑red hydraulic floor jack is pumped up and down while hydraulic fluid drips, then the handle is removed and the jack is lowered and pushed across the floor.
summary.detailed: The camera stays focused on a black‑and‑red hydraulic floor jack resting on a concrete surface. Around the jack are a blue tarp, a red‑and‑yellow screwdriver, an oil bottle, a small black container and, later, a grease gun with a red hose. Starting just after 162 seconds, a hand repeatedly pulls the red cylindrical handle upward, raising the jack, and then pushes the handle down, lowering the jack; this up‑and‑down motion continues for several seconds and a few drops of brown hydraulic fluid fall from the cylinder. The same pumping action persists through the next few seconds, with the background tools remaining static. From about 177 to 184 seconds the handle is moved more slowly downward while fluid continues to leak. After 184 seconds the motion speeds up: the handle is repeatedly pulled back and forth, the jack shifts slightly, and more fluid drips onto the concrete. Near the end of the segment the handle is pulled completely out of the jack and left on the floor, the jack is fully lowered to rest on its side, and finally the jack is pushed across the floor as the video concludes.

action.detailed: Pull the red handle upward to raise the jack, push it down to lower the jack repeatedly while hydraulic fluid drips, then remove the handle and set the jack down, and finally push the jack across the floor.

nodes.plm_action: Locate the battery in the car
nodes.plm_caption:
The video features a closeup shot of a collection of car maintenance tools placed on a ledge. The tools include a jack, a screwdriver, a bottle of oil and a rubber mallet. The shot begins low with a slight tilt up, revealing the ledge that the tools rest on. The person holding the camera moves it to the right, allowing the viewer to see the tools in greater detail.
The tools are clean and free of clutter on the concrete ledge, making it easy to identify what each tool is used for. The lighting is clear and focused.

nodes.plm_action: Holding up a bottle of Gold Eagle hydraulic jack oil
nodes.plm_caption: A bottle of hydraulic jack oil is shown from various angles. The camera then moves to a red and black hydraulic jack, which has a red and black handle lying beside it on the ground. While the camera pans around the jack, a hand picks up the bottle of hydraulic jack oil and shows it, before going back to the jack. The bottle of hydraulic jack oil is moved around, then set down on the ground. The camera then goes back to the jack and a hand is seen extending to open it. A black and red rectangular object is taken out of the hydraulic jack, shown to the camera, and then set down on the ground. The camera pans back to the jack. It is a cloudy day.

summary.brief: A hand shows a bottle of hydraulic jack oil, moves it around the jack, then opens the jack’s cover and removes the oil‑fill plug.
summary.detailed: The clip begins with a bottle of hydraulic jack oil displayed from several angles on a concrete floor among other tools. The camera then shifts to a red‑and‑black hydraulic floor jack with its handle nearby. A hand picks up the oil bottle, holds it up for the viewer, circles it around the jack, and places the bottle back down next to the jack. The hand reaches toward the jack, lifts the top cover, pulls out a black‑red rectangular component that serves as the oil‑fill plug, and shows it to the camera before putting it aside. Afterwards the hand moves the jack’s lever left‑right and up‑down a few times, briefly lifts the cover again, and finally sets both the oil bottle and the plug back on the floor as a cloudy sky is visible in the background.

action.detailed: Pull up the floor jack’s top cover, remove the black‑red rectangular oil‑fill plug, swing the jack lever left and right, and then place the oil bottle and plug back down.

nodes.plm_action: Apply upward force to lift jack off ground
nodes.plm_caption: This video features a jack with a lever being turned and pressed against a concrete floor.  There is a red metal handle on the left of the jack.

summary.brief: A hand turns a screw on a floor jack and pumps its red handle to raise and lower the jack.
summary.detailed: The camera stays on a black hydraulic floor jack sitting on a concrete floor. First a hand moves over the jack, points at a small screw or valve near the spring mechanism and turns it clockwise. The same hand then grabs the red hydraulic lever, inserts it into the jack’s pumping socket and swings it up and down. Each pump stroke extends the jack’s ram, lifting the vehicle that rests on the jack, and the reverse stroke retracts the ram, lowering the vehicle. This raising‑and‑lowering motion is repeated several times while the surrounding concrete floor, striped tiles and other tools remain visible. Near the end of the segment the view shifts to a low angle showing the hand operating the same red lever as the jack continues its motion.

action.detailed: Turn the valve screw clockwise, then pull and push the red hydraulic handle to raise and lower the floor jack.

nodes.plm_action: Pump up hydraulic floor jack
nodes.plm_caption:
In this video we see a man talking about car jacks and showing you how to use them. He also has all the supplies laying around to assist with his tutorial.
The man lays out all of the tools he is using before starting the tutorial and then proceeds to describe them. He is only using his hands to demonstrate how to use the tools. One piece is shown to lift the top part of the jack while he is showing how to apply oil before putting the jack in use. Overall the video is a good example of how to do something in a step by step way.
The video starts off showing a view of a jack and then moves around, pointing out different items in the scene. His hands are shown demonstrating the use of one tool, but he is not using his hands to hold anything other than the tool he is using to demonstrate. The tools and items he has laid out around his workspace add credibility to the tutorial and makes it more detailed.
The man uses his hands to demonstrate how to use the tool. He puts oil onto the tool, and then demonstrates how to use it. His hands are shown moving and manipulating the tool, giving us step by step instructions on how to do it. There are no other people in the video, and the background is not a constant scene, so it is good that the man takes the time to explain how to use the tools. He provides extra context and instructions on how to use them in a helpful way.

summary.brief: The presenter refills the floor‑jack’s hydraulic reservoir with fresh fluid.
summary.detailed: The video shows the presenter first opening the jack’s relief valve, then removing the filler plug to expose the float inside the hydraulic reservoir. After checking the float level, he pours new hydraulic oil from a bottle into the reservoir, continuing until the oil reaches the mark on the screw (the “M” line). He then replaces the filler plug and closes the relief valve, confirming that the jack is topped up and ready for use.

action.detailed: Release the jack’s relief valve, remove the filler plug, inspect the float, pour new hydraulic oil until the level reaches the screw mark, then reinstall the plug and close the valve.
action.actor: the presenter (a person operating the floor jack)

nodes.plm_action: Apply lubricant to chain rollers
nodes.plm_caption: A red tool is being used to fix a black metal object. The background is a worn concrete block wall.

summary.brief: A hand pulls the red handle of a black floor jack on a concrete step.
summary.detailed: In a close‑up view, a black hydraulic floor jack sits on a weathered concrete step while a long red handle extends from its rear; a hand grips the handle and pulls it upward, raising the jack and causing a small jet of brown hydraulic fluid to spurt, with the blurred concrete wall behind.

action.detailed: Pull the red handle upward to raise the floor jack.

nodes.plm_caption: A video of a red tool being used to make a hole in a black object. The tool is being inserted into the black object and moved back and forth, making the hole bigger and bigger. The background shows a wooden piece of counter or workbench, on the right there is a red handle tool that can be used to drive the red tool inside further. The handle tool is sitting on the counter.

nodes.plm_action: Applying brake fluid to the master cylinder using a funnel
nodes.plm_caption: In the background, there is a blue tarp, a red handle screwdriver, a jack, a bottle of oil, a metal object, a concrete floor, and a mat. In this video, the jack's arm is being lifted. The jack lifts up and down. And in the background there are black object.

summary.brief: A hydraulic floor jack is repeatedly raised and lowered on a concrete floor while nearby tools stay still.
summary.detailed: The clip shows a close‑up of a black hydraulic floor jack with red accents on a concrete surface. A hand grips the red handle, pulls it upward to raise the jack’s ram, then pushes it down, creating a slow up‑and‑down pumping motion that continues throughout the segment. To the right of the jack a black oil bottle with a pointed tip is visible, and a red‑and‑yellow screwdriver lies nearby. A blue tarp is partially visible in the upper‑right corner and a mat covers part of the floor. The surrounding tools and background remain stationary while the jack is operated.

action.detailed: Pull the red handle upward to raise the jack’s ram, then push it down to lower the ram, repeating this pumping motion.

nodes.plm_action: Pull down on lever to lift jack
nodes.plm_caption: A jack with a red and black handle is placed on a cement surface next to a black oil container and a red and yellow screwdriver. The jack starts pumping up and down and oil is dripped from it. There is a small black container and a blue plastic sheet visible in the video.

summary.brief: A red‑and‑black hydraulic floor jack is repeatedly pumped on a cement slab while hydraulic fluid drips, with an oil bottle, screwdriver and other tools nearby.
summary.detailed: The clip opens on a close‑up of a black hydraulic jack with a red handle resting on a cement surface, a black oil bottle and a red‑and‑yellow screwdriver placed to its right and a small metal object to its left. A hand pulls the red handle outward, extending the jack; when the handle is released the jack retracts, and a dark brown hydraulic fluid drips from the outlet each cycle. The handle is moved up and down several times in quick succession, causing the jack to pump repeatedly and slide slightly across the floor as drops of fluid fall onto the concrete. During the fast‑motion portion additional items—the black rectangular container, a pair of pliers, and a grease gun with a red hose—are visible around the jack. Eventually the handle is removed and left on the ground while the jack settles in its lowered position. The segment ends with a close‑up of the jack oil bottle (a black bottle with an orange label) beside the jack as more oil drips onto the floor while a voice is heard speaking.

action.detailed: Pull the red handle up and down repeatedly, raising and lowering the jack while hydraulic fluid drips from its hose.

The video is in color and the image is bright.

nodes.plm_action: Prepare oil.
nodes.plm_caption: The video features a concrete ledge with tools and machinery positioned beside it. The tools include a metal jack-like piece, a red and black pipe, a red and yellow tool, and a bottle of oil. The machinery is red with a black section in the center.

nodes.plm_action: Get the jack oil
nodes.plm_caption: The video shows a jack and the jack oil that should be used.

summary.brief: A man holds a bottle of Jack Oil and pours it into a floor jack.
summary.detailed: The clip begins with a bottle of Jack Oil placed next to a red floor jack on a concrete floor. The demonstrator picks up the bottle, points at the jack, and tilts the bottle to pour hydraulic fluid into the jack’s oil filler opening, then flips the bottle to finish the pour. After the fluid is added, he presses a red valve/button on the jack, moves the bottle aside, and briefly shows the bottle again in front of a doorway with a welcome mat, a vacuum cleaner and a bucket.

action.detailed: Hold the Jack Oil bottle, tilt it to pour the fluid into the jack’s filler, press the jack’s red valve, and place the bottle aside.

nodes.plm_action: Obtaining hydraulic jack oil
nodes.plm_caption:
A close-up shot of a dark-skinned hand holding a black bottle of hydraulic oil. The oil bottle has a white and orange label that says, "Jack Oil. " His hand shakes the bottle, then places it on the ground. He shows it again before opening the oil bottle's cap. The hand then opens the hydraulic pump, taking the cap off of it.
In the background is a brick house exterior with a cement sidewalk, a pair of boots, and a doormat. To the right is a white bucket and sprayer with a black nozzle. The ground is also wet. The video has a small blue cloth to the right.
The shot is a close-up shot. The person also shakes the hydraulic pump machine while opening the cap.

summary.brief: A hand shows a hydraulic jack oil bottle, opens its cap and the jack’s fill cover, then operates the jack’s red handle.
summary.detailed: The close‑up begins with a dark‑skinned hand holding a black bottle of hydraulic jack oil, shaking it and rotating it to display the label before placing the bottle on a concrete floor beside a hydraulic floor jack. The hand unscrews and removes the bottle’s cap, then reaches to the jack, unscrews the small black plastic cover that seals the jack’s fill port and sets the cover aside. After the fill opening is exposed, the hand pushes the jack’s red handle upward, slides a flat red object beneath the jack, and then pushes the handle back down, demonstrating the jack’s motion. In the background a brick wall, cement sidewalk, a white bucket with a sprayer, a pair of boots, a doormat, a wet floor and a small blue cloth are visible.

action.brief: Open jack fill port and operate handle
action.detailed: Rotate the oil bottle, unscrew its cap, unscrew the jack’s fill‑port cover, remove the black plug, then push the jack’s red handle up and down while sliding a flat object beneath the jack.

nodes.plm_action: Remove the bolt and screw on the motor mount
nodes.plm_caption: The video features a close up of a black jack with red handles placed on the floor and a human hand pointing at it. The human moves the hand from the left to the right. towards the middle.

summary.brief: A hand points to and turns a bolt on a black floor jack with red handles.
summary.detailed: The camera shows a close‑up of a black hydraulic floor jack with red handles sitting on a concrete floor. A presenter’s hand moves from the left side of the frame toward the centre, points at a visible bolt (the hydraulic valve), grasps it and rotates it counter‑clockwise, demonstrating how to release the valve before the jack is used.

action.detailed: Grasp the jack’s bolt with the hand and rotate it counter‑clockwise to release the hydraulic valve.
action.actor: the presenter’s hand (person demonstrating the floor jack)

nodes.plm_action: Inserting screwdriver into jack handle
nodes.plm_caption:
A tool which lifts very heavy things is positioned and then operated. A man speaking is heard in the background. The tool is black and has a red handle. Other tools lay on the floor. The floor has cream and brown stripes. The lighting is outdoor, natural day light.
A tool is on the floor and a hand is seen operating it. The man speaking can be heard.
The floor has cream and brown stripes. It is an outdoor, natural day light setting.

summary.brief: A man inserts a red handle into a black hydraulic jack, turns it, and pumps the jack up and down.
summary.detailed: The scene shows a black hydraulic floor jack standing on a cream‑and‑brown striped concrete floor outdoors, with other tools scattered nearby. A man's hand grabs the red handle, inserts it into the jack’s central socket and turns it clockwise, causing the jack to shift slightly backward. A short red hose or tube is then fitted onto the jack. The hand pulls the handle upward, extending the hydraulic ram and lifting the jack (or the vehicle under it), then releases and pushes the handle down to lower it. This up‑and‑down motion repeats several times, while the jack’s internal lever moves on its own. In a later close‑up, a bolt and wires are visible under the handle, and a tool is used to adjust the jack, with tiled flooring in the background. Finally, the jack is shown lifting a car wheel, moving up and down repeatedly.

action.detailed: Grasp the red handle, insert it into the jack’s socket, turn clockwise to engage, then pull the handle upward to raise the jack and push it down to lower it, repeating the motion as needed.

nodes.plm_action: Tightening the jack with a special wrench
nodes.plm_caption: This video shows how to use a jack on to lift your vehicle.

summary.brief: The presenter turns the red lever of a floor jack, raising the piston slightly, then lifts the jack and moves it away while a rug and nearby tools are visible.
summary.detailed: The clip opens on a floor jack sitting on a concrete‑looking floor beside a black‑and‑white rug and the edge of a white bucket. The presenter grabs the red lever on the jack and rotates it clockwise; the lever moves and the hydraulic piston extends, causing the jack’s metal rod to rise a short distance. The camera tilts upward, showing the jack partially lifted. After the lever is released the jack lowers again, and the presenter then picks up the whole jack and carries it off the rug. In the background a red‑handled tool, a small black box that looks like a battery, and an empty bag lie on the floor.

action.brief: raise and relocate the floor jack
action.detailed: Turn the red lever clockwise to extend the jack’s piston, lift the jack slightly, release the lever, then pick up the jack and place it aside.
action.actor: the person operating the floor jack (hands)

nodes.plm_action: Applying brake fluid using a funnel
nodes.plm_caption:
This video captures the creation of a demonstrating of a working jack for the purpose of repairing a car. The jack has various mechanical parts inside that allow the user to maintain a hold on a car as you jack up the tires.
This video showcases the main action of creating a detailed tutorial for a car jack. This jack has multiple key components that are necessary for a successful operation and it is shown from all sides so the user can effectively understand it better.

summary.brief: A close‑up of the jack’s underside gives way to the presenter refilling it with hydraulic fluid.
summary.detailed: The segment opens with a tight view of the floor jack’s lower chassis on a brown‑concrete surface: a metal spring, a vertical rod, a red button, three silver bolts and a cylindrical tube are visible while the spring briefly compresses and rebounds and a lever with a red knob moves. The camera then pulls back to show the jack on a concrete floor surrounded by various oil bottles, a transparent container, a red‑yellow‑handled tool, a hammer and other cleaning supplies. summary_sent_to_llm.title: How to add or change Hydraulic fluid on Floor Jack
summary_sent_to_llm.root_summary: The video begins with the presenter holding two bottles of jack oil and pointing at the jack’s oil seal. He removes the jack’s cover, exposing a rubber seal and dip‑stick, then releases the pressure valve and checks the float inside. After opening the oil bottle, he pours new hydraulic fluid into the reservoir until the fill mark on the screw is visible, replaces the cover and re‑closes the valve. He then grasps the red‑and‑yellow pump handle, repeatedly pulls it up and pushes it down, causing the jack to raise and lower while a small stream of brown fluid drips from the seal, and finally sets the handle aside as the demonstration ends.

raise and relocate the floor jack
Pour oil onto the floor jack

press button and slide oil pan

llm.system_prompt:
You evaluate YouTube videos for a video-understanding benchmark.

You will be given an Action100M-style summary of one video: title, description,
a hierarchical GPT-written summary of the whole video, and a deduplicated list
of action labels extracted at multiple levels of the video.

Your job is to judge:

1) DOMAINS — does this video clearly belong to either of these target domains?
   - "kitchen": a person preparing food in a kitchen-like setting
     (cooking, baking, food prep — NOT eating reviews, NOT pet-food prep,
     NOT food-product unboxing, NOT restaurant vlogs).
   - "manipulation": a person performing hand-object manipulation tasks
     with clear physical goals: assembly/disassembly, repair, crafting,
     tool use, packing, sorting. The video must show clear procedural
     manipulation, NOT just incidental hand movement (e.g. a vlog where
     someone holds things while talking does NOT count).
   A video can match neither, one, or both. Be strict — when in doubt,
   say "neither".

2) NUM_DISTINCT_EVENTS — count the number of *semantically distinct*
   sub-events (procedural steps) you see in the action list. Merge
   paraphrases of the same step into one. Ignore generic narration steps
   like "speak to camera" or "display title".

3) IS_GOOD_CANDIDATE — true only if BOTH:
   - at least one target domain matches
   - num_distinct_events > 3 (the video shows a real multi-step procedure)

Always return strict JSON in the requested schema.
